_note: FLWO 60-inch (Tillinghast) with TRES: one telescope in one dome.
One file for the enclosure, read by both services (robofast_core/config.py):
tillinghast.telescope: the TCSGO server (sites/flwo60/tcsgo.json listens on 11140).
tillinghast.camera: the TRES CCD's Alpaca camera (to be written; placeholder).
tillinghast.calstage: the TRES front end's calibration stage (sites/flwo60/tres_frontend.json listens on 11160; docs/tres_frontend.md).
dome: the 60-inch dome's Alpaca server; the TCSGO server's dome/0 if the TCS drives the dome (unconfirmed), else its own server.
safetymonitor, observingconditions: a weather bridge for Mt. Hopkins (placeholder).
No hardware heartbeat: the TCS has none, and the dome has no watchdog (JDE 2026-10-31: none he is aware of), so nothing closes the dome if the supervisor dies.

So safety.attended_only (also the default without a heartbeat): no lease, and the dome never opens, unless an operator is on duty through the observer console ('on duty', renewed while the page is open). duty_ttl s without a renewal: a critical alarm; duty_grace s later the supervisor closes (docs/console.md, Operator duty).
site: the 60-inch on Mt. Hopkins, approximate (public).
name: flwo60
